prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a tightly controlled six-figure character pose comparison sheet of the EXACT pink Dango creature in attached references 1 and 2. These are the ONLY visual references and the sole identity authority. Reference 1 is front; reference 2 is right three-quarter. This task is a small pose edit, not a character redesign.
Layout: three rows × two columns on a plain light warm-gray background, generous spacing. LEFT column always exact front. RIGHT column always exact right three-quarter with both eyes visible. Row 1 NEUTRAL, row 2 CUP, row 3 CRYSTAL. Small captions outside the figures only.
The first row must reproduce the canonical resting shape very faithfully: same round belly, body width/height, two little triangular ears, exact eye sizes and positions, tiny horizontal mouth, two original stub feet, stepped dark silhouette, restrained pink gradient and texture. No new side tail, no additional limb bumps, no crouching or four-legged stance. Keep this same unchanged body, feet and facial landmarks in the other rows.
For CUP and CRYSTAL, reveal only TINY, SHORT, FIN-LIKE PINK HANDS growing naturally from the body’s sides. They are modest body protrusions, not arms with forearms, wrists, elbows or shoulders. Each visible hand is no larger than a small fraction of the body, approximately the scale of one original stub foot or smaller. The full round belly remains clearly readable. NO enlarged arms spanning across the abdomen, no muscular biceps, no swollen side pouch, no horizontal belly folds.
The root flows directly into the torso with NO BLACK ARMPIT LINE, NO ROOT CREASE, no enclosed seam, no joint circle and no drawn connector. Use only the existing outer silhouette and a minimal rounded exposed fin/paw edge to explain the hand. No fingers, nails, knuckles or toe notches. The tiny paw should feel like the canonical foot material extending from the same body.
CUP row: a small cream ceramic tea cup with one subtle green leaf motif, held close against the lower torso. Keep the normal tiny mouth and eyes unchanged. Select prop placement and near/far occlusion that make it genuinely supportable by the tiny fins, rather than lengthening the arms to reach a remote grip. The far paw may be partly hidden by the cup/body naturally.
CRYSTAL row: a small warm golden faceted energy crystal embraced close against the lower torso. Keep it clear of the eyes and retain the same normal face. The little paws touch its near side edges with believable overlap, without forming a large pair of central fists.
All six figures use identical character scale, body proportions, face layout, palette, contour weight and tiny-step texture. Only the small hands and props may be added for the last two rows. No costume, hat, scarf, boots, bag, cape, exercise reference, floor pose, action marks, sweat, blush additions, shadows or scenery. No smooth vector style, no 3D and no fluffy fur. This is image-only anatomy review before any asset production; prioritize canonical identity and restrained natural small hands.
